defs.def: anxious about sth or afraid of sth 焦虑的；担忧的；惶恐的

ex.s: I was desperately nervous when I went to her office the next day.
ex.t: 保护传粉昆虫。

ex.s: But now that I was doing it, I ___4___ felt nervous.

ex.t: 我开始变得非常紧张。

ex.t: "我不知道会在那里找到什么，我也不紧张，我只想去做。

ex.t: 他说他变得和台上演奏乐器的人一样紧张。

ex.s: The deep, gentle voice helped calm the nervous girl.
ex.t: 呼吁公共图书馆系统的现代化。

ex.s: Nervously   2   （face） challenges.

ex.t: 我们有些人自信且渴望参加课堂活动，其他人则紧张不安。

ex.s: The real McNay was splendid， but we felt nervous the whole time we were there． Van Gogh， Picasso． This time， we stayed together， in case anything else unusual happened．
ex.t: "那是我的家。我当时是个青少年，坐在大厅里。在你们过来之前，我从未意识到我住的地方多么美丽。我以前从未觉得自己幸运。你们以为它是博物馆。那次经历之后我对家的感觉改变了。我一直想感谢你们。"

ex.s: B． She felt nervous when talking to strangers．

ex.s: I woke up sweating and nervous, but ready to prove something to myself.
ex.t: 事实上，我和第一名得到的是同样的奖牌。

ex.s: A nervous night to be sure, but sometimes the spirits of nature smile on us all!
ex.t: 莫兰说爵士乐今天的问题之一是音乐的娱乐性已经丧失。

ex.s: The instructor kept repeating the word, “Speed up!” “Slow down!” “Turning left!” I was so much nervous that I could hardly tell which direction was left.
ex.t: 教练不断重复着："加速！" "减速！" "左转！" 我紧张得几乎分不清哪边是左。

defs.def: easily worried or frightened 神经质的；易紧张焦虑的；胆怯的

ex.s: I had been too nervous to pay attention when he introduced himself!
ex.t: 我太紧张了，他自我介绍的时候我都没注意！

ex.s: During the English class Meng Hao was nervous about introducing himself in front of the class.
ex.t: 在英语课上，孟浩对于在全班面前介绍自己感到很紧张。

ex.s: Son: (nervously approaching the table) Erm...Dad, can we talk?
ex.t: 儿子：（紧张地走近桌子）嗯……爸爸，我们能谈谈吗？

ex.s: We could also say I was very nervous when I saw the test paper.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：当我看到试卷时我非常紧张。

ex.s: Whether I'm at the gym or on the road, my nervous energy pushes me through mile one.
ex.t: 不管我是在健身房还是在路上，我的紧张能量推动我跑完第一英里。

defs.def: connected with the body's nerves and often affecting you mentally or emotionally 神经系统的
